Daily Litre Limit — Multi-Scan Enforcement
Each household can scan any tap, multiple times per day. The system tracks their total litres collected. Once they hit the daily limit, ALL taps are blocked for their card. Access resets automatically at midnight.

🚰
🚰
TAPS
10L + 20L
Flow: Borehole pumps water → stored in 2,000L Tank → passed through Purification System → PLC S7-1200 controls valve logic → Daily Limit Check gates access → Taps dispense.  Example: Daily limit = 100L. household scans Tap 2 (20L) × 3 = 60L, then Tap 1 (80L) — system only dispenses 40L (remaining), then blocks the card. Tomorrow they start fresh at 0L.
